# cube-cos-snapshot Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Rebuild the Cube Snapshot Generator as a React 19 + TS SPA on `@cube-frontend/ui-library`, served and generated by a single static Go binary.

**Architecture:** Go binary (stdlib `net/http`) embeds the Vite-built SPA via `go:embed`, exposes a small `/api/v1/clusters` REST API, and renders the three hex policy YAMLs + `.snapshot` zips natively (no shell-outs). Frontend is a pnpm workspace consuming `@cube-frontend/ui-library`/`ui-theme` from a `cube-cos-ui` git submodule. YAML output correctness is locked by golden files captured from the legacy JS implementation.

**Tech Stack:** Go ≥1.24 (stdlib only, no third-party deps), React 19, TypeScript, Vite 8, Tailwind 3 + cubePreset, pnpm ≥10.33 + Node ≥24.15, vitest.

## Global Constraints

- Air-gapped: no runtime downloads anywhere; all assets embedded in the binary.
- The `clusterDetail` JSON schema is **unchanged** from the legacy app (see spec + `internal/model`); old exported files must import cleanly.
- `.snapshot` zip layout identical to legacy: `etc/policies/{cubesys,network,time}/*.yml`, `etc/appliance/state/{sla_accepted,configured}`, `Comment`.
- Generated YAML must match legacy byte-for-byte (golden tests); `Comment` differs only in timestamp.
- Legacy source of truth for ported logic: `/root/cube-snapshot-generator` (branch `develop`).
- cube-cos-ui idioms: copy patterns from `packages/cube-frontend-keycloak-login` (small-app blueprint) and `packages/cube-frontend-web-app`.
- Conventional commits, `git commit -s` (DCO). No Claude trailers.
- Build tooling: `source /root/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 24`, corepack pnpm (see `packageManager` in cube-cos-ui root package.json). Go 1.26 is on PATH.
- Node ≥24.15 / pnpm ≥10.33 are build-time only; the shipped artifact is one Linux amd64 binary.

## Reference: clusterDetail JSON shape (legacy, unchanged)

```jsonc
{
  "clusterInfo": { "id": "<uuid>", "name": "cluster-1" },
  "clusterConfig": {
    "DNS": ["8.8.8.8", "1.1.1.1"],            // 1-2 entries
    "timezone": { "name": "Asia/Taipei", "offset": 480 },
    "roleSettings": {
      "extIP": "10.0.0.10",                    // may be ""
      "region": "RegionOne",
      "secretSeed": "xzpfwk",
      "mgmtCIDR": "10.254.0.0/16"
    },
    "HA": true,
    "HASettings": { "virtualIP": "10.254.0.100", "virtualHostname": "virtual-host" } // {} when HA=false
  },
  "nodeData": [
    {
      "id": "<uuid>",
      "hostname": "node-1",
      "initIFs": [ { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init", "name": "IF.1", "enabled": true,
                     "IPAddr": "10.254.0.1", "IPMask": "255.255.0.0", "master": "<uuid-or-absent>" } ],
      "bondIFs": [ { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "bond", "name": "bond0", "enabled": true,
                     "IPAddr": "...", "IPMask": "...", "slaves": ["<uuid>"] } ],
      "vlanIFs": [ { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "vlan", "name": "bond0.101", "enabled": true,
                     "IPAddr": "...", "IPMask": "...", "master": "<uuid>" } ],
      "defaultIF": { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init" },
      "defaultGateway": "10.254.0.254",
      "role": "control-converged",             // control|compute|storage|control-converged|edge-core|moderator
      "roleSettings": {
        "mgmtIF": { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init" },
        "providerIF": { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init" },   // role-dependent
        "overlayIF": { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init" },    // role-dependent
        "storIF": { "id": "<uuid>", "type": "init" },
        "storIFBackend": {}                                  // {} or IFInfo
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Cluster id used on disk/API = `id[len-12:]` ("short id").

```go
type IF struct {
	ID      string   `json:"id"`
	Type    string   `json:"type"` // init|bond|vlan
	Name    string   `json:"name"`
	Enabled bool     `json:"enabled"`
	IPAddr  string   `json:"IPAddr,omitempty"`
	IPMask  string   `json:"IPMask,omitempty"`
	Master  string   `json:"master,omitempty"`
	Slaves  []string `json:"slaves,omitempty"`
}
type IFInfo struct { ID string `json:"id,omitempty"`; Type string `json:"type,omitempty"` }
type NodeRoleSettings struct {
	MgmtIF       IFInfo `json:"mgmtIF"`
	ProviderIF   IFInfo `json:"providerIF,omitempty"`
	OverlayIF    IFInfo `json:"overlayIF,omitempty"`
	StorIF       IFInfo `json:"storIF"`
	StorIFBackend IFInfo `json:"storIFBackend"` // zero value == {} in legacy
}
type NodeConfig struct {
	ID string `json:"id"`; Hostname string `json:"hostname"`
	InitIFs []IF `json:"initIFs"`; BondIFs []IF `json:"bondIFs"`; VlanIFs []IF `json:"vlanIFs"`
	DefaultIF IFInfo `json:"defaultIF"`; DefaultGateway string `json:"defaultGateway"`
	Role string `json:"role"`; RoleSettings NodeRoleSettings `json:"roleSettings"`
}
type Timezone struct { Name string `json:"name"`; Offset int `json:"offset"` }
type ClusterRoleSettings struct { ExtIP, Region, SecretSeed, MgmtCIDR string /* json tags extIP, region, secretSeed, mgmtCIDR */ }
type HASettings struct { VirtualIP string `json:"virtualIP,omitempty"`; VirtualHostname string `json:"virtualHostname,omitempty"` }
type ClusterConfig struct {
	DNS []string `json:"DNS"`; Timezone Timezone `json:"timezone"`
	RoleSettings ClusterRoleSettings `json:"roleSettings"`
	HA bool `json:"HA"`; HASettings HASettings `json:"HASettings"`
}
type ClusterInfo struct { ID string `json:"id"`; Name string `json:"name"` }
type ClusterDetail struct {
	ClusterInfo ClusterInfo `json:"clusterInfo"`
	ClusterConfig ClusterConfig `json:"clusterConfig"`
	NodeData []NodeConfig `json:"nodeData"`
}
func (c ClusterDetail) ShortID() string            // last 12 chars of ClusterInfo.ID
func (c ClusterDetail) Validate() error            // see Step 1 cases
func HasControlFunc(role string) bool              // control|control-converged|edge-core|moderator
func (n NodeConfig) AllIFs() []IF                  // init+bond+vlan concat
func (n NodeConfig) IFName(id string) string       // name lookup, "None" if missing
```

`Validate()` rules (mirror legacy server-side assumptions; return wrapped `ErrInvalid`): cluster id len ≥12; name non-empty; role ∈ the 6 roles; ≥1 DNS; every node hostname non-empty + unique; every node's `mgmtIF.id`/`storIF.id` (+ provider/overlay for roles that need them per `roleOptions` matrix) resolve via `IFName` ≠ "None"; HA=true ⇒ VirtualIP+VirtualHostname non-empty; ≥1 control-func node when any node role needs `ctrlHostname` (compute/storage present).

```js
// usage: cd /root/cube-snapshot-generator && node /root/cube-cos-snapshot/tools/gen-golden.mjs
import fs from 'fs'; import path from 'path';
import { createRequire } from 'module';
const require = createRequire('/root/cube-snapshot-generator/');
const { getCubsysYaml, getNetworkYaml, getTimeYaml } = require('./server/routers/getYaml.js');
const { getControlInfo } = require('./server/routers/utils.js');
const SRC = '/root/cube-cos-snapshot/internal/generator/testdata';
for (const f of fs.readdirSync(path.join(SRC, 'fixtures'))) {
  const d = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(SRC, 'fixtures', f)));
  const ctl = getControlInfo(d.nodeData);
  for (const node of d.nodeData) {
    const out = path.join(SRC, 'golden', path.parse(f).name, node.hostname);
    fs.mkdirSync(out, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'cubesys1_0.yml'), getCubsysYaml(node, d.clusterConfig, ctl));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'network1_0.yml'), getNetworkYaml(node, d.clusterConfig));
    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(out, 'time1_0.yml'), getTimeYaml(d.clusterConfig));
  }
}
console.log('golden files written');
```

### Task 4: YAML renderers (`internal/generator`)

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/generator/yamlwriter.go`, `internal/generator/render.go`
- Test: `internal/generator/render_test.go` (golden comparison)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `model.*` from Task 2.
- Produces: `func RenderCubesys(n model.NodeConfig, cc model.ClusterConfig, ctl ControlInfo) string`, `RenderNetwork(n, cc) string`, `RenderTime(cc) string`, `type ControlInfo struct{ Hostnames, IPs []string }`, `func GetControlInfo(nodes []model.NodeConfig) ControlInfo`.

Implementation notes (exact legacy semantics from `server/routers/getYaml.js` + `utils.js` — read both before coding):
- js-yaml emitted `key:` (nothing) for null/empty values (`'!!null': 'empty'` + isEmpty replacer). Reproduce with a tiny ordered writer, NOT a YAML lib:

```go
// yamlwriter.go — ordered document writer reproducing js-yaml output for our shapes.
type doc struct{ b strings.Builder }
func (d *doc) kv(indent int, key string, val any)   // val nil / "" / empty slice → "key:"; bool → true/false; string plain; int as-is
func (d *doc) raw(indent int, line string)
```
- Header/prefix per file: `---\n# cubesys/cubesys1_0.yml\n` etc.; `version: 1.0` literal.
- cubesys key order: `name, version, role, domain, ha, saltkey, controller`, then role-dependent cluster keys in `roleOptions.cluster[role]` order (`controller` overwrite, `controller-ip`, `external`, `region`, `secret-seed`, `mgmt-cidr`), then node keys in `roleOptions.node[role]` order (`management, provider, overlay, storage` — storage joins backend with `,`), then HA extras (`control-vip` only for control-func roles, `control-hosts`, `control-addrs` joined with `,`). **Beware**: legacy builds one JS object then dumps — a later `controller` assignment replaces the earlier key *in place* (insertion order kept). Match golden order exactly.
- network: interface `type` ints — vlan→3, bond→1, init w/o master→0, init w/ master→2; `gateway:` only on the default IF else `gateway:` empty (null); disabled IF ⇒ `ipv4: {dhcp: true}` only; ipv6 always `{enabled: true, dhcp: true}`; `master: <name>` line when IF.Master set. dns: `auto: false`, `primary`, optional `secondary`.
- js-yaml quoting: strings needing quotes get single-quoted — goldens will reveal if any of our values need it (IPs/hostnames/tz don't).

### Task 5: Snapshot zip assembly

**Files:**
- Create: `internal/generator/template/` — copy of legacy `storage/snapshot_template/**` (6 files; keep empty `.yml` placeholders)
- Create: `internal/generator/snapshot.go`
- Test: `internal/generator/snapshot_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Produces: `func BuildNodeSnapshot(n model.NodeConfig, d model.ClusterDetail, ctl ControlInfo, now time.Time) ([]byte, error)` (zip bytes) and `func BuildClusterZip(shortID string, detailJSON []byte, snapshots map[string][]byte) ([]byte, error)`.

Behavior:
- Node snapshot zip entries = template tree with the three policy files replaced by rendered YAML, plus `Comment` = `Generated for <clusterName> on 2006-01-02 15:04:05\n` (use `now`). Entry names relative, forward slashes, no leading `./` (e.g. `Comment`, `etc/policies/cubesys/cubesys1_0.yml`). Template embedded: `//go:embed all:template`.
- Cluster zip entries: `<shortID>/clusterDetail.json` + `<shortID>/<hostname>.snapshot` (matching legacy `zip -r <id>.zip <id>/*.snapshot <id>/*.json`).

- Test: `internal/storage/store_test.go`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: generator + model.
- Produces:

```go
type Store struct{ DataDir, ExportDir string }
type Digest struct { ID string `json:"id"`; Name string `json:"name"`; Nodes []string `json:"nodes"` }
func (s *Store) Save(d model.ClusterDetail) error      // validate → render+zip all in memory → write temp dir → atomic swap
func (s *Store) List() ([]Digest, error)               // scan DataDir dirs having clusterDetail.json
func (s *Store) Detail(shortID string) (model.ClusterDetail, error)   // ErrNotFound
func (s *Store) Delete(shortID string) error
func (s *Store) ClusterZipPath(shortID string) (path, downloadName string, err error) // downloadName "<clusterName>.zip"
func (s *Store) SnapshotPath(shortID, hostname string) (string, error)
var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")
```

On-disk layout (same as legacy): `<DataDir>/<shortID>/{clusterDetail.json, <host>.snapshot...}` + `<DataDir>/<shortID>.zip`. `Save` writes to `<DataDir>/.tmp-<shortID>-<rand>` then removes old dir/zip and renames — a failed generation never clobbers existing state. When `ExportDir != ""`, after swap copy each `<host>.snapshot` flat into ExportDir; on Save-over-existing or Delete, remove ExportDir files for hostnames that belonged to the previous version (read old clusterDetail first).
